facts.claim: NewsBreak uses personalization technology to tailor local news.
facts.quote: NewsBreak’s cutting-edge personalization technology responds to your choices and reading habits in the app and tailors itself to suit your tastes.

facts.claim: NewsBreak focuses on community building through local stories.
facts.quote: NewsBreak focuses on local news that brings communities together around the important stories they share in common.

facts.claim: NewsBreak aims to empower local communities and businesses.
facts.quote: Connect and empower local users, local content creators, and local businesses at scale

facts.claim: NewsBreak delivers breaking news directly to users.
facts.quote: All your local and breaking news, right at your fingertips.

facts.claim: NewsBreak uses timely push notifications for neighborhood events.
facts.quote: Timely alerts and push notifications keep you on top of what’s happening in your neighborhood and around the country.

facts.claim: NewsBreak is a mobile application delivering localized notifications.
facts.quote: Timely alerts and push notifications keep you on top of what’s happening in your neighborhood and around the country.

facts.claim: NewsBreak runs a creator program inviting writers and video creators to share local content.
facts.quote: Become a NewsBreak creator! Your stories. Your spotlight.
